theme: Splitting overlapping peaks into real compounds
title: Column Tailing: Untangling a Chromatogram into True Compounds
strategies: blind uniform baseline: declare every reference slot present, area = total trace mass split evenly across all M slots
symmetric independent matched filter: per reference slot, window-sum the trace around its nominal retention time assuming a plain (tau=0) Gaussian shape, no cross-slot deconvolution

shared-tau joint EMG deconvolution: grid-search one column tailing constant tau shared by every basis function, jointly non-negative-least-squares fit all M exponentially-modified-Gaussian columns at once, and keep the tau that minimizes residual
